samples.summary: New mutating NoteEditorAPI methods (toggleQuote / insertCodeBlock / insertFoldout) have no read-only check; read-only notes are only protected by `EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)` (packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:355), which does not block programmatic `view.dispatch`. The only real guard is the toolbar's UI-level `canFormat` (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-toolbar.tsx:237), so any future/other consumer of the exported API can mutate a read-only note. Consistent with the pre-existing toggleBold/insertTable pattern, so this widens an existing surface rather than creating a new one; the fix, if wanted, belongs in the new commands (or a shared guard in editor.ts's API wiring).
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:355 `EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)` is the only engine-side read-only enforcement; packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:505-507 expose toggleQuote/insertCodeBlock/insertFoldout unconditionally, and packages/notes/src/view/commands.ts:213-300 dispatch changes without consulting `state.readOnly`.
searchedFor: Grep editor.(insert|toggle) call sites in packages/frontend/src
